mapper.sql: WITH ranked AS ( SELECT ds.*, COALESCE(NULLIF(ds.parent_asin, ''), ds.asin) AS product_key, CASE WHEN ds.units IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN' WHEN ds.units >= 100 THEN 'A' WHEN ds.units >= 50 THEN 'B' WHEN ds.units >= 15 THEN 'C' ELSE 'D' END AS sales_tier_calc, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(ds.node_label_path, ':', -1)), ''), 'UNKNOWN') AS category_leaf, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY ds.marketplace, ds.seller_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(ds.parent_asin, ''), ds.asin) ORDER BY CASE WHEN ds.batch_date IS NULL OR ds.batch_date = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, ds.batch_date DESC, CASE WHEN ds.bsr IS NULL OR ds.bsr <= 0 THEN 999999999 ELSE ds.bsr END ASC, ds.created_at DESC, ds.id DESC ) AS rn FROM deng_zong_shop ds

INSERT INTO shop_profile_category ( marketplace, seller_name, batch_date, variation_mode, sales_tier, category_key, product_count, units_sum, units_avg, source_table, computed_at, created_at, updated_at )
WHERE ds.title IS NOT NULL AND ds.asin IS NOT NULL AND ds.seller_name IS NOT NULL AND ds.batch_date = #{batchDate} AND ds.marketplace = #{marketplace} ), base AS (SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1), tiered AS ( SELECT marketplace, seller_name, sales_tier_calc AS sales_tier, category_leaf, units FROM base UNION ALL SELECT marketplace, seller_name, 'ABC' AS sales_tier, category_leaf, units FROM base WHERE sales_tier_calc IN ('A','B','C') ) SELECT marketplace, seller_name, #{batchDate} AS batch_date, 'Y' AS variation_mode, sales_tier, category_leaf AS category_key, COUNT(*) AS product_count, COALESCE(SUM(units), 0) AS units_sum, ROUND(AVG(units), 2) AS units_avg, 'deng_zong_shop' AS source_table, NOW() AS computed_at, NOW() AS created_at, NOW() AS updated_at FROM tiered GROUP BY marketplace, seller_name, sales_tier, category_leaf ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE product_count = VALUES(product_count), units_sum = VALUES(units_sum), units_avg = VALUES(units_avg), computed_at = VALUES(computed_at), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.sql: WITH ranked AS ( SELECT ds.*, COALESCE(NULLIF(ds.parent_asin, ''), ds.asin) AS product_key, CASE WHEN ds.units IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN' WHEN ds.units >= 100 THEN 'A' WHEN ds.units >= 50 THEN 'B' WHEN ds.units >= 15 THEN 'C' ELSE 'D' END AS sales_tier_calc, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(ds.node_label_path, ':', -1)), ''), 'UNKNOWN') AS category_leaf, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY ds.marketplace, ds.seller_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(ds.parent_asin, ''), ds.asin) ORDER BY CASE WHEN ds.batch_date IS NULL OR ds.batch_date = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, ds.batch_date DESC, CASE WHEN ds.bsr IS NULL OR ds.bsr <= 0 THEN 999999999 ELSE ds.bsr END ASC, ds.created_at DESC, ds.id DESC ) AS rn FROM shop_products ds

unknownCount, SUM(CASE WHEN e.sales_tier_calc IN ('A','B') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abCount, SUM(CASE WHEN e.sales_tier_calc IN ('A','B','C') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abcCount, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN WHERE ds.title IS NOT NULL AND ds.asin IS NOT NULL AND ds.seller_name IS NOT NULL AND ds.marketplace = #{marketplace} AND ds.seller_name = #{sellerName} AND ds.batch_date = #{batchDate} AND ds.source_run_id = #{sourceRunId} ), base AS ( SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ), enriched AS ( SELECT base.*, AS m01_hit FROM base ) SELECT sales_tier_calc AS salesTier, COUNT(*) AS productCount, SUM(m01_hit) AS m01HitCount, ROUND(SUM(m01_hit) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS m01HitRatio, ROUND(AVG(listing_days), 2) AS avgListingDays, ROUND(AVG(units), 2) AS avgUnits, MIN(CASE WHEN available_date IS NOT NULL AND available_date > 0 THEN available_date END) AS earliestAvailableDate, DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(MIN(CASE WHEN available_date IS NOT NULL AND available_date > 0 THEN available_date END) / 1000), '%Y-%m-%d') AS earliestAvailableDateText, MAX(listing_days) AS maxListingDays, SUM(CASE WHEN listing_days IS NOT NULL AND listing_days <= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS new30Count, SUM(CASE WHEN listing_days IS NOT NULL AND listing_days <= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS new90Count, SUM(CASE WHEN listing_days IS NOT NULL AND listing_days <= 180 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS new180Count, SUM(CASE WHEN listing_days IS NOT NULL AND listing_days > 180 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS old180Count, SUM(CASE WHEN listing_days IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unknownListingDaysCount FROM enriched GROUP BY sales_tier_calc ORDER BY CASE sales_tier_calc WHEN 'A' THEN 1 WHEN 'B' THEN 2 WHEN 'C' THEN 3 WHEN 'D' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END ASC

WHERE ds.title IS NOT NULL AND ds.asin IS NOT NULL AND ds.seller_name IS NOT NULL AND ds.marketplace = #{marketplace} AND ds.seller_name = #{sellerName} AND ds.batch_date = #{batchDate} AND ds.source_run_id = #{sourceRunId} ), base AS ( SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ), enriched AS ( SELECT base.*, AS m01_hit FROM base ) SELECT sales_tier_calc AS salesTier, category_leaf AS categoryKey, MAX(node_label_path) AS nodeLabelPath, COUNT(*) AS productCount, COALESCE(SUM(units), 0) AS unitsSum, ROUND(AVG(units), 2) AS unitsAvg, ROUND(AVG(listing_days), 2) AS avgListingDays, SUM(m01_hit) AS m01HitCount, ROUND(SUM(m01_hit) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS m01HitRatio FROM enriched GROUP BY sales_tier_calc, category_leaf ORDER BY CASE sales_tier_calc WHEN 'A' THEN 1 WHEN 'B' THEN 2 WHEN 'C' THEN 3 WHEN 'D' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END ASC, productCount DESC, category_leaf ASC
